about: Florida building-permit due-diligence records, normalized. Stage 2 of docs/plans/florida-permit-cluster-2026-11.md. One verified county so far (Collier, 2026-11-17). Every row traces to source_registry; every test row is something we actually ran. Nothing here is rendered on the site yet.

verification_tests.subject: 3299 and 3301 Tamiami Trl E, Naples (Collier County Government Center, owner COLLIER COUNTY)
verification_tests.steps: Building Review and Permitting; Permit Address Number + Permit Street Name; variants TAMIAMI / TAMIAMI TRL / TAMIAMI TRAIL / tamiami trl / E TAMIAMI; partial permit number 2008; opened 2011061518
verification_tests.result: 3299+TAMIAMI: 5 permits (4 COED, 1 SUSPEND), issued 01/11/2011-07/14/2011. Suffix variants: 0. 3301+TAMIAMI: 200 rows (cap), 1989-2004, COED 148 / VOID 31 / SUSPEND 21. 2011061518: fire alarm, SUSPEND, issued 7/14/2011, expired 1/10/2012, CO blank, 5 inspection codes with no results.
verification_tests.limits: Pattern seen at one public address; CityView view of the same permits not checked (region-blocked).

permit_status_definitions.county_meaning: CDPlus: job completed, inspected, all conditions resolved; CO or CC issued.
CDPlus: permit has been cancelled with proper docs provided; no further action; no longer an open issue.
Application or permit requires action: reapply, or cancel by request.
CDPlus: requires additional research; may need extension, reapplication or suspension.
Not actively pursued as the FBC requires; needs research; may need extension, reapplication or cancellation.
Cancelled with proper docs; no further action; not an open issue.
Completed, inspected, conditions resolved; CO or CC issued.
The county web page's closed list (COED, Finaled, Abandoned, Denied, Cancelled) omits SUSPEND, which Bulletin 14 defines as closed.

statewide_rules.rule: From 2026-07-01 a local government shall exempt a single-family owner or contractor from a permit for work valued at less than $7,500; not electrical, plumbing, structural, mechanical or gas work; not in a flood hazard area; written exemption request with contract required.
A single-family dwelling permit expires 1 year after issuance or on the next FBC edition's effective date, whichever is later; local government may extend.
Any property owner may close a building permit, including with a different licensed contractor.
